item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southern China in the next couple of days. An upper-air disturbance is expected to affect the coast of southern China gradually in the latter part of this week. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region during the weekend. Besides, the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong early next week. Temperatures will fall slightly and the weather will improve over the region in the following couple of days. It will also be dry during the day.
